denominator_rule: Every entry in this finite version is classified. Adding or removing an entry changes the denominator and must be disclosed as scope evolution, never disguised as progress or regression.

entry_contract.current: Requires at least one live owner reference and a bounded support statement.
entry_contract.partial: Requires owner references for the implemented slice plus at least one actionable gap reference.
entry_contract.incomplete: Missing, gated, excluded, and unknown entries require at least one dispositioned gap reference.
entry_contract.catalog_presence: An entry documents the landscape; it is not a support promise unless state=current.

entries.title: Evidence-to-decision traceability
entries.current_scope: Supported observations retain a path through canonical facts, findings, recommendations, gates, and produced artifacts.

entries.title: Coverage-honest conclusions
entries.current_scope: Observed, clean, finding, not-observed, missing, malformed, and unknown are not intentionally collapsed for supported evidence contracts.

entries.title: Phase-gated migration governance
entries.current_scope: Assess, approval, design, peer review, MOP/rollback, dry-run/CAB, acceptance, cutover, and PIR remain distinct governed steps.

entries.title: Cross-artifact consistency
entries.current_scope: The twelve-artifact pre-cutover family derives from the same snapshot and uses explicit completeness and manifest controls; the thirteenth lifecycle record is the conditional post-execution PIR and requires an AssessHub execution run.

entries.title: Portable offline assessment
entries.current_scope: The core engine and portable Atlas path are designed to operate without external egress; live collection remains explicit and authorized.

entries.title: Business-service impact traceability
entries.current_scope: Application domains, criticality, blast radius, and migration groups exist, but a complete service catalog, dependency graph, and value model do not.

entries.title: Real-estate outcome validation
entries.current_scope: No client or owner-machine evidence is admitted to this repository-owned reference layer, so adoption and achieved business outcomes are unknown here.

entries.title: Autonomous remediation and closed-loop change
entries.current_scope: Intentionally excluded: Atlas proposes and verifies but never writes devices or self-approves a change.

entries.title: Bounded evidence intake
entries.current_scope: Supported files, directories, archives, and uploads are constrained before interpretation.

entries.title: Same-read custody binding
entries.current_scope: File identity, bytes, digest, length, and before/after metadata are bound around the read used for parsing.

entries.title: Canonical assessment snapshot
entries.current_scope: One normalized snapshot owns shared assessment facts and reconciliation state for supported inputs.

entries.title: Assessment MCP over a produced snapshot
entries.current_scope: An optional read-only MCP server exposes bounded, coverage-honest tools over an already-produced snapshot. The default stdio transport opens no socket; optional SSE/streamable-HTTP modes listen only on loopback but serve snapshot content without application authentication, so they are a local trust-boundary choice rather than a supported public API.

entries.title: Architecture-class coverage accounting
entries.current_scope: The registry reports observed, clean, finding, or not-observed for 27 declared architecture classes and 46 detectors.

entries.title: Integrity, provenance, and authority separation
entries.current_scope: Registry bytes may be integral without being authoritative; source scope and authority remain explicit.

entries.title: Decision and gate state machine
entries.current_scope: Recommendations, approvals, execution evidence, validation, and completion are separately recorded and fail closed.

entries.title: Static master-reference projection
entries.current_scope: This reference is repository-owned static content with no evidence intake, runtime API, storage, cookies, or analytics.

entries.title: Cross-domain unknown-signal queue
entries.current_scope: The always-present unknown_evidence/1 projection aggregates parser exceptions, suspicious zero-yield, unregistered parser and coverage axes, and unsupported shapes from the bounded parse-yield, coverage-matrix, and architecture-coverage inputs into aggregate-only needs-triage events mapped to capability and gap IDs with a fixed coverage-governance owner role. It does not provide universal platform, protocol, not-assessable, feature-request, or incident intake, nor a durable human disposition, SLA, per-item owner assignment, expiry, promotion, or dashboard workflow.

entries.title: STP and loop-avoidance behavior
entries.current_scope: Captured STP state supports health, root placement, blocked-path, inconsistency, blast-radius, and advisory reasoning; full standards and vendor variance are not claimed.

entries.title: EtherChannel, LACP, and PAgP
entries.current_scope: Bundle membership and selected abnormal member flags are parsed and explained; timer, hashing, multi-chassis, and vendor depth are incomplete.

entries.title: VTP
entries.current_scope: Operating mode, domain, revision, and high-revision risk have bounded parsing and advice; complete version and pruning behavior are not modeled.

entries.title: CDP, LLDP, ARP, ND, and endpoint learning
entries.current_scope: Captured neighbor, MAC, ARP/ND, and interface evidence contributes to topology and endpoint context. Atlas does not claim complete CDP/LLDP protocol validation, authoritative endpoint identity, or time-continuous learning.

entries.title: Static and default routing
entries.current_scope: Captured route and gateway evidence can support bounded dependency and FIB-oriented views. Recursive resolution, object tracking, VRF leaking, floating-static behavior, and cross-vendor parity are incomplete.

entries.title: OSPFv2
entries.current_scope: Neighbor state, selected stuck-state intelligence, and routing-topology views exist; LSDB, area design, policy, convergence, and scale verification are incomplete.

entries.title: BGP
entries.current_scope: Peer state and selected failure-state intelligence exist, with selected EVPN/VPN detectors; policy, RIB scale, best-path, security, RR, and convergence depth are incomplete.

entries.title: EIGRP
entries.current_scope: Observed neighbor-up state contributes to protocol health and topology; topology table, feasibility, stubs, variance, authentication, and failure-state advice are incomplete.

entries.title: RIP and RIPng
entries.current_scope: RIP/RIPng neighbor, route, timer, authentication, policy, and convergence behavior are not an owned assessment capability.

entries.title: Policy-based routing and route policy
entries.current_scope: PBR, route maps/policies, redistribution, filtering, set actions, and their RIB/FIB consequences are not evaluated end to end.

entries.title: HSRP, VRRP, and GLBP first-hop redundancy
entries.current_scope: Gateway redundancy, split-brain/mismatch, tracking, preemption, and selected failure implications are assessed; timers and full vendor behavior are incomplete.

entries.title: NTP
entries.current_scope: Time-synchronization presence and management baseline have selected assessment coverage; offset, jitter, stratum quality, authentication, and fleet chronology are incomplete.

entries.title: VXLAN-EVPN
entries.current_scope: Selected NVE peer, EVPN control-plane, and VNI state detectors exist; route-type, multihoming, DF, policy, DCI, and endpoint validation are incomplete.

entries.title: MPLS LDP, L3VPN, and L2VPN
entries.current_scope: Selected LDP session, VPNv4, and pseudowire-down detectors exist; label forwarding, TE, OAM, route-target policy, and service assurance are incomplete.

entries.title: PIM-SM and multicast RPF
entries.current_scope: Selected RP-resilience and RPF-failure detection exists; source discovery, SSM, MSDP, BSR, mVPN, BIER, and end-to-end receiver proof are incomplete.

entries.title: BFD
entries.current_scope: A selected session-down/failover-degraded detector exists; interval design, echo, multihop, demand mode, scaling, and client correlation are incomplete.

entries.title: LISP and SD-Access fabric state
entries.current_scope: Selected fabric-session-down detection exists; mapping systems, VN policy, border/control-plane design, and end-to-end SDA assurance are incomplete.

entries.title: TrustSec / CTS
entries.current_scope: Selected environment-data failure detection exists; SGT propagation, SGACL policy, pxGrid context, and path enforcement proof are incomplete.

entries.title: DMVPN / NHRP
entries.current_scope: Selected tunnel-peer-down detection exists; phases, spoke-to-spoke behavior, routing interaction, crypto, QoS, and scale are incomplete.

entries.title: IPsec encrypted WAN
entries.current_scope: Selected crypto-session-down detection exists; IKE negotiation, selectors, rekey, PKI, performance, remote access, and end-to-end policy are incomplete.

entries.title: IPv6 ND, DAD, OSPFv3, and BGP
entries.current_scope: Selected duplicate-address, adjacency, and first-hop-security detection exists; dual-stack design, RA/DHCPv6, policy, transition, and Internet reachability are incomplete.

entries.title: Syslog
entries.current_scope: Captured operational logs contribute selected event intelligence; reliable transport, facility/severity policy, collector delivery, retention, chronology, and SIEM integration are incomplete.

entries.title: TACACS+, RADIUS, 802.1X, and EAP
entries.current_scope: Configuration and selected ISE deployment evidence can expose posture; authentication transactions, EAP methods, authorization policy, accounting, and identity-path proof are incomplete.

entries.title: SNMP
entries.current_scope: No continuous SNMP inventory, polling, trap, MIB-coverage, or credential-posture capability is claimed.

entries.title: NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gNOI, YANG, and OpenConfig
entries.current_scope: Controller-specific REST collection does not establish model-driven network-management support.

entries.title: DNS, DHCP, DHCPv6, and IPAM
entries.current_scope: No authoritative service health, lease, DDI dependency, DNSSEC, or address-governance model is claimed.

entries.title: 802.11, CAPWAP, roaming, and Passpoint
entries.current_scope: Access-point discovery in topology does not establish WLAN RF, controller, client, roaming, or authentication analysis.

entries.title: MACsec and MKA
entries.current_scope: No link-encryption, key-agreement, cipher, replay, or policy validation is claimed.

entries.title: CFM, Y.1731, TWAMP, IP SLA, and MPLS OAM
entries.current_scope: No end-to-end service OAM or active performance assurance is claimed.

entries.title: RPKI/ROV, ASPA, BGPsec, source validation, RTBH, and FlowSpec
entries.current_scope: BGP peer-state assessment does not establish Internet routing security or DDoS signaling support.

entries.title: BGP route reflection, communities, add-path, GR, PIC, and labeled-unicast
entries.current_scope: No complete control-plane policy, scale, path-selection, or convergence model is claimed.

entries.title: MSDP, BSR, Auto-RP, SSM, mVPN, and BIER
entries.current_scope: Selected PIM/RPF findings do not establish complete multicast service support.

entries.title: SR-MPLS, SRv6, TI-LFA, and fast reroute
entries.current_scope: No segment-routing policy, SID, locator, repair-path, or convergence assessment is claimed.

entries.title: IS-IS, PCEP, BGP-LS, and RIFT
entries.current_scope: No link-state, topology export, path-computation, or fat-tree routing analysis is claimed for these families.

entries.title: PTP, SyncE, TSN, and DetNet
entries.current_scope: Application-domain hints do not establish precision-time, bounded-latency, or deterministic-network assurance.

entries.title: RoCEv2, RDMA, DCB, PFC, and ECN
entries.current_scope: No lossless-fabric congestion, pause, queue, ECN, or RDMA behavior model is claimed.

entries.title: NAT64, DNS64, 464XLAT, transition, and CGNAT
entries.current_scope: Selected IPv6 findings do not establish translation, subscriber NAT, logging, or application compatibility assessment.

entries.title: QUIC and HTTP/3
entries.current_scope: No encrypted application-transport classification, policy, performance, or troubleshooting support is claimed.

entries.title: Physical and cable path
entries.current_scope: Neighbor and interface evidence powers a role-tier cable map and selected link-health findings; optical, circuit, power, and facility dependencies are incomplete.

entries.title: Per-VLAN L2 path and blast radius
entries.current_scope: For supported captured topology, Explorer and analysis compute forwarding/blocked paths, partitions, backups, articulation points, and device-removal blast effects.

entries.title: Gateway and bounded L3 dependency path
entries.current_scope: Gateway, FHRP, routing adjacency, and selected path dependencies are modeled. Traffic Assurance adds exact-destination lookup and recursive next-hop closure over a current-run scoped IPv4 RIB plus bounded ECMP consistency, but it is not a device FIB, is not VRF-aware, and abstains for policy-based routing or configured uRPF; complete RIB/FIB, route leaking, and policy-routing behavior remain incomplete.

entries.title: Overlay and tenant path
entries.current_scope: Selected overlay health and architecture classes are observed, but an authoritative per-tenant overlay path and policy-provenance model is absent.

entries.title: Bounded synthetic L4 Traffic Assurance
entries.current_scope: For an exact declared IPv4 TCP/UDP tuple, Traffic Assurance composes requested forward and return scoped-RIB paths, stateless interface ACLs, observed per-hop MTU, ECMP consistency, current-run evidence custody, and optionally one synthetic node/site/link failure into one canonical verdict. Unsupported or incomplete semantics abstain. Explorer retains its bounded ACL lens. This is not stateful firewall/session or NAT/PAT reasoning, observed live traffic, application proof, runtime rule-hit evidence, or field validation.

entries.title: Actual flow and packet evidence
entries.current_scope: Synthetic Traffic Assurance verdicts are not observed traffic. No NetFlow/IPFIX/sFlow, packet capture, session-table, active application probe, or streaming flow datastore is claimed.

entries.title: Application delivery and digital experience
entries.current_scope: No authoritative DNS/LB/proxy/TLS dependency, synthetic transaction, latency, jitter, loss, or MOS proof is claimed.

entries.title: Hybrid, SaaS, Internet, and multicloud path
entries.current_scope: A bounded AWS security-group detector does not establish external routing, provider, SaaS, sovereignty, resilience, or egress-cost paths.

entries.title: Demand, capacity, microburst, and growth forecasting
entries.current_scope: Snapshot port/PoE/capacity signals exist; time-series demand, buffer/microburst behavior, forecasts, confidence bounds, and cost curves are incomplete.

entries.title: Campus hierarchical architecture
entries.current_scope: Captured access/distribution/core topology, L2/L3 resilience, capacity, security posture, and selected leading-practice conformance are assessed; no claim spans every campus technology.

entries.title: SD-Access and Catalyst Center
entries.current_scope: Selected LISP and TrustSec evidence does not constitute Catalyst Center collection, fabric assurance, LAN automation, policy, inventory, image, or migration assessment.

entries.title: Branch, remote workforce, and Internet edge
entries.current_scope: Selected WAN, VPN, and firewall detectors do not constitute a branch or remote-work architecture assessment.

entries.title: WAN and SD-WAN
entries.current_scope: DMVPN, IPsec, BFD, selected MPLS, and vManage/SD-WAN evidence have bounded detection; transport diversity, SLA policy, application routing, QoS, Internet exit, and operations are incomplete.

entries.title: Classic data-center architecture
entries.current_scope: Captured topology, VLAN, routing, gateway, redundancy, capacity, and selected service evidence supports a bounded classic data-center review; compute, load-balancing, storage, facilities, and application dependency depth are incomplete.

entries.title: VXLAN-EVPN data-center fabric
entries.current_scope: Selected NVE, VNI, EVPN, underlay, and migration evidence has bounded detectors; route types, multihoming, policy, services, DCI, operations, and vendor parity are incomplete.

entries.title: Cisco ACI architecture
entries.current_scope: APIC collection and selected fabric health, tenant, fault, endpoint, enforcement, and move-group evidence exist; complete policy, contracts, L3Out, services, multisite, upgrade, and operations proof does not.

entries.title: DNS, DHCP, IPAM, NTP, AAA, PKI, proxy, and load-balancing services
entries.current_scope: NTP, AAA/config, and selected identity evidence exist; no unified network-services dependency or resiliency model is claimed.

entries.title: Enterprise wireless, location, and private cellular
entries.current_scope: No RF, WLAN controller, roaming, location, private-5G, or mobility design assessment is claimed.

entries.title: IPv6 and transition architecture
entries.current_scope: Selected ND, DAD, FHS, OSPFv3, and BGP evidence is assessed; addressing, dual-stack, translation, security parity, DNS, application readiness, and Internet strategy are incomplete.

entries.title: DCI, multisite, and multiregion resilience
entries.current_scope: No complete failure-domain, data-replication, route-policy, application-consistency, or recovery-point/time architecture is claimed.

entries.title: Hybrid and multicloud networking
entries.current_scope: A bounded AWS security-group exposure detector exists; no Azure/GCP, transit, interconnect, DNS, firewall, identity, route, sovereignty, or cost architecture is complete.

entries.title: Kubernetes CNI, service mesh, eBPF, and multicluster
entries.current_scope: No cluster-network, workload-identity, service-policy, eBPF, or mesh dependency assessment is claimed.

entries.title: AI/HPC Ethernet and lossless fabrics
entries.current_scope: No GPU-fabric topology, RoCE/RDMA, DCB/PFC/ECN, congestion, incast, or job-impact analysis is claimed.

entries.title: Storage and SAN fabrics
entries.current_scope: No Fibre Channel, FCoE, NVMe/TCP, multipathing, zoning, replication, or storage-service dependency assessment is claimed.

entries.title: Voice, video, collaboration, broadcast, and real-time media
entries.current_scope: QoS posture and application-domain hints exist; call control, media path, MOS, multicast, PTP, jitter, loss, and admission control are incomplete.

entries.title: Out-of-band management, cabling, optics, power, and facilities
entries.current_scope: Cable, interface, PoE, and selected platform signals exist; console/OOB reachability, circuits, racks, PDUs, UPS, environmental sensors, optics budgets, and physical diversity are incomplete.

entries.title: SASE, SSE, zero trust, and remote access
entries.current_scope: TrustSec, ISE, firewall, and IPsec slices do not establish a complete identity-to-application SASE or zero-trust architecture.

entries.title: Business continuity, disaster recovery, and survivability
entries.current_scope: Topology failure simulation, redundancy, migration rollback, and acceptance gates exist; business-service RTO/RPO, multi-site exercises, backup restoration, and crisis communications are incomplete.

entries.title: Energy, sustainability, licensing, and network FinOps
entries.current_scope: No energy/carbon baseline, license optimization, carrier/cloud cost, or lifecycle-TCO model is claimed.

entries.title: Service-provider and transport architecture
entries.current_scope: Atlas has selected MPLS and routing detectors but no authoritative carrier/service lifecycle, TE, SR, optical, mobile transport, wholesale, SLA, or multi-domain provider design assessment.

entries.title: OT and IoT architecture
entries.current_scope: No safety-bound industrial zones/conduits, deterministic control traffic, passive asset discovery, protocol, lifecycle, or operational-availability design assessment is claimed.

entries.title: Automation and enterprise source-of-truth architecture
entries.current_scope: Atlas has internal canonical-fact ownership and deterministic outputs, but it does not assess or integrate customer NetBox/Nautobot, CMDB, GitOps, intent, orchestration, drift, or reconciliation architecture end to end.

entries.title: Sovereignty, residency, and regional architecture
entries.current_scope: Privacy boundaries exist for the toolkit, but Atlas does not produce jurisdiction-specific data-flow, control-plane residency, lawful-access, regional failover, or regulatory architecture proof.

entries.title: Read-only assessment boundary
entries.current_scope: Device changes are forbidden; controller collection is opt-in and GET-only after authentication with a dedicated read-only RBAC account.

entries.title: Server-owned trust labels
entries.current_scope: Uploaded content cannot self-assert server verification or trusted provenance.

entries.title: Independent redaction verification
entries.current_scope: Supported JSON, HTML, and OOXML outputs receive independent verification rather than producer self-attestation.

entries.title: Repository and release privacy gate
entries.current_scope: Tracked, untracked, ignored, and packaged content is scanned under the repository privacy contract and bounded exception policy.

entries.title: Configuration hardening and CIS posture
entries.current_scope: Selected Cisco configuration and CIS checks contribute findings; full platform, benchmark-version, compensating-control, and remediation validation coverage is incomplete.

entries.title: Layer-2 and IPv6 first-hop protections
entries.current_scope: Port security, storm control, and selected IPv6 first-hop-security suites have detectors; DHCP snooping, DAI, RA guard, source guard, and vendor parity are incomplete.

entries.title: Firewall HA and capacity
entries.current_scope: Selected Cisco ASA/FTD HA and resource-exhaustion detectors exist; rules, objects, NAT, sessions, threats, VPN, upgrades, and multi-vendor policy proof are incomplete.

entries.title: Identity, NAC, and Cisco ISE
entries.current_scope: Opt-in read-only ISE Open API and ERS collection feeds node reachability and deployment-redundancy detectors; authentication journeys, policy sets, posture, guest/BYOD, pxGrid, and authorization outcomes are incomplete.

entries.title: Exact product lifecycle authority
entries.current_scope: A product is classified only when an exact bounded scope maps to the owned lifecycle evidence; unresolved products abstain.

entries.title: External vulnerability and advisory intelligence
entries.current_scope: A sanitized hash-sealed, unauthenticated advisory feed path exists; exact platform applicability, source authentication, SBOM, KEV/EPSS fusion, and closed-loop remediation are incomplete.

entries.title: PKI, certificates, keys, MACsec, and crypto agility
entries.current_scope: No certificate inventory, chain validation, expiry, key custody, algorithm posture, PQC migration, or MACsec assurance is claimed.

entries.title: Routing security, source validation, and DDoS controls
entries.current_scope: No RPKI/ROV, ASPA, BGPsec, SAV, RTBH, FlowSpec, scrubbing, or DDoS readiness assessment is claimed.

entries.title: Wireless security
entries.current_scope: No WPA3, 802.1X/EAP, rogue, segmentation, guest, Passpoint, RF-security, or WLAN-controller policy assessment is claimed.

entries.title: Cloud IAM, KMS, workload identity, and Kubernetes network policy
entries.current_scope: A security-group exposure detector does not establish identity, encryption, workload, cluster, secret, or admission-control security coverage.

entries.title: IDS/IPS, NDR, WAF, proxy, EDR, and posture correlation
entries.current_scope: No threat-detection event, signature, behavioral, endpoint, web, or response correlation platform is claimed.

entries.title: Incident response, forensics, and threat hunting
entries.current_scope: Operational logs can inform findings, but Atlas does not claim case management, forensic preservation, hunting, containment, or response orchestration.

entries.title: OT/IoT security with safety and availability constraints
entries.current_scope: No ISA/IEC 62443 zone/conduit, passive discovery, safety-impact, OT protocol, or change-freeze assessment is claimed.

entries.title: Privacy, data residency, retention, and regulatory profiles
entries.current_scope: Repository and artifact privacy controls are strong; product-level retention, sovereignty, legal basis, regional hosting, and sector profiles are not complete.

entries.title: AI and agent security
entries.current_scope: Local and quarantined knowledge controls exist, but no formal prompt-injection, model, agent-tool, data-exfiltration, evaluation, or AI governance capability is claimed.

entries.title: Point-in-time canonical snapshot
entries.current_scope: Supported collected evidence is normalized into a canonical snapshot with reconciliation and coverage state.

entries.title: Collection completeness and parse yield
entries.current_scope: Coverage, completeness, integrity, parse-yield signals, and a bounded aggregate-only unknown-evidence projection exist for supported evidence; universal cross-domain intake, durable human disposition and expiry, and continuous freshness remain incomplete.

entries.title: Health, risk, readiness, and causality views
entries.current_scope: Snapshot health, grouped readiness, cross-layer findings, causal flows, and priority views exist for supported evidence.

entries.title: Configuration drift and compliance
entries.current_scope: Golden and feature-level configuration compliance signals exist; configuration backup, GitOps source, intended-state reconciliation, and fleet change history are incomplete.

entries.title: Logs and operational events
entries.current_scope: Captured syslog events contribute bounded intelligence; centralized streaming, normalization, correlation, retention, search, and case linkage are incomplete.

entries.title: Metrics and time-series telemetry
entries.current_scope: No continuous metrics store, polling, cardinality policy, retention, alerting, or dashboard platform is claimed.

entries.title: Flow telemetry
entries.current_scope: No NetFlow, IPFIX, sFlow, cloud-flow-log, or long-lived flow analytics pipeline is claimed.

entries.title: Packet evidence
entries.current_scope: No packet-capture acquisition, indexing, protocol decode, payload privacy, or replay workflow is claimed.

entries.title: Distributed traces and application spans
entries.current_scope: No OpenTelemetry trace, span, service dependency, or network-to-application correlation is claimed.

entries.title: Synthetics and digital-experience monitoring
entries.current_scope: No scheduled application transaction, endpoint experience, Internet vantage, or MOS monitoring is claimed.

entries.title: Business service maps, SLOs, and error budgets
entries.current_scope: Application grouping does not establish a live service graph, owner, SLI, SLO, burn rate, or error budget.

entries.title: Anomaly detection and root-cause assistance
entries.current_scope: Deterministic cross-layer and causal synthesis exists for captured snapshots; statistical baselines, time-series anomalies, uncertainty calibration, and multi-domain RCA are incomplete.

entries.title: Capacity and failure forecasting
entries.current_scope: Snapshot capacity signals and lifecycle bands exist; trend models, growth horizons, seasonality, failure prediction, and calibration are incomplete.

entries.title: FCAPS and ITSM integration
entries.current_scope: No incident, problem, change, request, asset, event, or ticket-system integration is claimed.

entries.title: CMDB, NetBox, inventory, and intended-state integration
entries.current_scope: Devices files and snapshots are evidence inputs, not an enterprise CMDB or intended-state authority.

entries.title: Lifecycle, maintenance, upgrades, contracts, and spares
entries.current_scope: Exact bounded lifecycle classification and migration artifacts exist; entitlement, warranty, licensing, spares, maintenance, upgrade cadence, and TAC readiness are incomplete.

entries.title: Backup, restore, DR exercises, and decommission
entries.current_scope: Runbook rollback is not a complete configuration backup, restore exercise, disaster recovery, secure decommission, or disposal capability.

entries.title: Safe closed-loop remediation
entries.current_scope: Automated device writes are outside the current safety boundary; any future proposal would require a separate authorization and enforcement architecture.

entries.title: Cisco IOS, IOS-XE, and NX-OS show-text channel
entries.current_scope: The primary engine collects and replays supported show-text evidence for core campus and selected data-center functions; command, release, and platform coverage is finite.

entries.title: Cisco ASA and FTD
entries.current_scope: Selected HA and resource detectors exist; policy, NAT, session, VPN, threat, and upgrade coverage is incomplete.

entries.title: Cisco ACI / APIC
entries.current_scope: Opt-in authenticated HTTPS collection writes selected APIC class JSON for offline parsing and bounded fabric/fault/enforcement detectors.

entries.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN / vManage
entries.current_scope: Opt-in authenticated HTTPS collection writes selected device/control/counter JSON for offline parsing and bounded SD-WAN detectors.

entries.title: Cisco ISE
entries.current_scope: An opt-in HTTPS collector reads ISE Open API and ERS deployment-node evidence for selected reachability and redundancy detectors; policy-transaction coverage and release-tagged lab validation remain incomplete.

entries.title: Cisco FMC-managed Secure Firewall
entries.current_scope: An opt-in HTTPS collector reads FMC-managed device, HA, deployable-state, manager-HA, and version evidence for selected detectors; full policy, NAT, session, and stateful-flow reasoning remain incomplete.

entries.title: Cisco Catalyst Center
entries.current_scope: No Catalyst Center inventory, assurance, topology, SDA fabric, policy, image-management, event, or task channel is claimed.

entries.title: Arista EOS
entries.current_scope: The architecture registry contains selected SSH-evidence MLAG and BGP-EVPN detectors; broad platform and feature parity is not claimed.

entries.title: Juniper SRX
entries.current_scope: The architecture registry contains a selected SSH-evidence chassis-cluster HA detector; broad Junos routing, switching, security, and policy coverage is not claimed.

entries.title: Fortinet FortiGate
entries.current_scope: The architecture registry contains a selected SSH-evidence HA synchronization detector; broad FortiOS policy, NAT, SD-WAN, threat, and VPN coverage is not claimed.

entries.title: F5 BIG-IP and application delivery
entries.current_scope: No F5 inventory, virtual-server, pool, monitor, persistence, TLS, DNS/GTM, WAF, HA, telemetry, or configuration channel is claimed.

entries.title: Aruba and HPE networking
entries.current_scope: No ArubaOS, AOS-CX, Central, ClearPass, AirWave, Comware, wireless, campus-fabric, or controller-specific channel is claimed.

entries.title: Nokia network platforms
entries.current_scope: No SR OS, SR Linux, NSP, IP/MPLS, EVPN, segment-routing, telemetry, or service-lifecycle channel is claimed.

entries.title: Huawei network platforms
entries.current_scope: No VRP, iMaster, campus, data-center, WAN, wireless, optical, telemetry, or security channel is claimed.

entries.title: AWS networking
entries.current_scope: A JSON-based public-cloud security-group open-ingress detector exists; VPC routing, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, NACL, load balancer, DNS, IAM, flow, and cost coverage is incomplete.

entries.title: Microsoft Azure networking
entries.current_scope: No VNet, vWAN, ExpressRoute, NSG, route, firewall, load balancer, DNS, flow-log, or identity channel is claimed.

entries.title: Google Cloud networking
entries.current_scope: No VPC, NCC, Interconnect, firewall, route, load balancer, DNS, flow-log, or identity channel is claimed.

entries.title: VMware networking and NSX
entries.current_scope: No vSphere distributed-switch, NSX overlay, segment, gateway, distributed-firewall, load-balancer, federation, traceflow, or telemetry channel is claimed.

entries.title: Palo Alto, Check Point, and other enterprise firewalls
entries.current_scope: No platform-specific collection, parse, policy, NAT, session, HA, or threat-analysis support is claimed.

entries.title: WLAN controllers and private cellular platforms
entries.current_scope: No controller-specific wireless, RF, client, roaming, location, NPN, or slicing channel is claimed.

entries.title: Offline show-text replay
entries.current_scope: Authorized captures can be re-analyzed offline with deterministic filename and parser contracts.

entries.title: Explicit live SSH collection
entries.current_scope: The primary collector is read-only by doctrine and only runs live when explicitly authorized; a bare assessment command is therefore operationally gated by the human.

entries.title: Controller REST collection
entries.current_scope: APIC, vManage, ISE, and FMC have opt-in HTTPS evidence collectors with bounded authentication, credential, pagination, and same-origin/no-downgrade controls appropriate to each API; cloud, WLAN, and other controllers lack equivalent live channels.

entries.title: Streaming telemetry and event APIs

entries.current_scope: A one-way sanitized digest can be produced and consumed on the owner machine, but it is gitignored, absent from clean clones, and never a repository prerequisite.

entries.current_scope: Schema and guardrails exist for quality trends and calibrated learning; real-data floors, sealed holdouts, hardware-limited evaluation, and human gates keep broad claims unavailable.

entries.title: Cited client-generic learnings
entries.current_scope: Verified engine lessons are kept concise, cited, repository-owned, and separate from personal-domain and client evidence.

entries.title: External knowledge promotion into assessment truth
entries.current_scope: Sanitized advisory feeds may inform a quarantined advisory lane, but promotion into assessment truth requires authority, applicability, tests, and a reviewed owner change.

entries.title: Interactive training and lab curriculum
entries.current_scope: This master-reference layer defines fourteen advisory lab contracts; lab execution harnesses, fixtures, answer keys, and assessment-safe promotion remain incomplete.
